background_rule: Any time not covered by a segment is BACKGROUND.

label_meaning.COVER: put the case side cover back on
label_meaning.FIXING_FAN: mount a fan (CPU cooler or case fan) in its place
label_meaning.INSERT: put a part in (motherboard, CPU, RAM stick, power supply, drive)
label_meaning.OPEN: open a latch or lever (e.g. RAM clip, CPU socket lever)
label_meaning.PLUG: connect a power or data cable
label_meaning.PLUG_FAN: connect a fan cable to the motherboard
label_meaning.SCREW: drive screws in with the screwdriver
label_meaning.UNCOVER: take the case side cover off
label_meaning.UNPLUG: disconnect a power or data cable
label_meaning.UNSCREW: take screws out with the screwdriver

segments.label: UNCOVER
segments.note: Side cover slid back, lifted off and put down on the right.

segments.label: UNPLUG
segments.note: Drive power and data cables disconnected at the top of the case; red SATA cable put aside around 65 s.

segments.label: UNPLUG_FAN
segments.note: Hand at the board next to the cooler just before it is unscrewed; most likely the cooler's fan cable being unplugged. Check.

segments.label: UNSCREW
segments.note: Screwdriver on the CPU cooler screws (the right hand holds the screwdriver at the cooler's corners). The screwdriver is picked up around 78 s.

segments.label: EXTRACT
segments.note: CPU cooler lifted out and put on the side panel.

segments.label: UNPLUG
segments.note: Both hands on the board, no tool; probably a cable. Check.

segments.label: EXTRACT
segments.note: A drive (black, held at 168.5 s) taken out and put on the right.

segments.label: UNSCREW
segments.note: Case stood up; screwdriver on the rear fan screws.

segments.label: EXTRACT
segments.note: Rear case fan taken out and put on the side panel.

segments.label: UNSCREW
segments.note: Screwdriver on the power-supply screws at the back.

segments.label: EXTRACT
segments.note: Power supply lifted out and put on the right.

segments.label: UNSCREW
segments.note: Motherboard screws taken out; short trips to put screws on the table are included. Around 238-247 s both hands are at the top right of the board, which could be another action. Check.

segments.label: EXTRACT
segments.note: Motherboard lifted out and put on the left.
